metadata.description: Subscription-scoped orchestrator for the narrow LIMS WS2025 DEV v2 SQL installation-media container RBAC exception (docs/scope.md): resolves and verifies the existing SQL v2 VM system-assigned identity in the DEV subscription (read-only — no resource is ever deployed there), then grants that identity exactly one built-in Storage Blob Data Reader role assignment scoped to the existing mssql-2022-source container in the MGMT subscription — never storage-account, resource-group, or subscription scope. Creates no VM, identity, storage account, container, custom role, account key, or SAS token. Deliberately cross-subscription: the DEV VM lookup and the MGMT role-assignment target are each an explicitly, separately scoped module — never conflated.

Full ARM resource ID of the existing DEV resource group hosting the SQL v2 VM, e.g. /subscriptions/<dev-subscription-id>/resourceGroups/rg-compute-lims-dev-westeu. The DEV subscription ID and resource group name are both derived from this single authoritative value. This composition creates no resource group and never deploys any resource into this subscription — the module scoped here performs a read-only existing-VM identity lookup only.
Resource name of the existing SQL v2 virtual machine, e.g. vm-lims-dev-v2-westeu-002. Referenced only as an existing resource for identity resolution — not created, modified, or redefined here.

Customer-attested expected principalId of the SQL VM system-assigned managed identity — verification evidence only. See modules/compute/lims-ws2025-dev-sql-media-rbac/resolve-sql-vm-identity.bicep for how it is used: it is never the functional identity passed to the role assignment, only an independent check against the live-resolved value.

Full ARM resource ID of the existing MGMT resource group hosting the installation-media storage account, e.g. /subscriptions/<mgmt-subscription-id>/resourceGroups/rg-core-lims-mgmt-westeu. The MGMT subscription ID and resource group name are both derived from this single authoritative value. This is the only subscription this composition deploys (creates) anything into — exactly one Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments resource, scoped to the container below.
Name of the existing storage account hosting the installation-media container, e.g. salimsmgmtwe. Referenced only as an existing resource — not created, modified, or redefined here.
Name of the existing blob container to grant read access to, e.g. mssql-2022-source. Referenced only as an existing resource — not created, modified, or redefined here.

Resolves and verifies the existing system-assigned managed identity principalId of the existing LIMS WS2025 DEV v2 SQL virtual machine, for the narrow SQL v2 installation-media container RBAC exception in docs/scope.md. References the VM as an existing resource only — creates, modifies, or replaces no identity. The supplied expectedSqlVmPrincipalId is verification evidence only: it is independently compared against the VM live-resolved identity.principalId, and this deployment fails closed if they do not match. The output is always the live-resolved value, never the supplied expected value, so it is never used as a hardcoded functional identity downstream.

Resource name of the existing SQL virtual machine whose system-assigned identity is resolved, e.g. vm-lims-dev-v2-westeu-002. Referenced only as an existing resource — not created, modified, or redefined here.

Customer-attested expected principalId of the SQL VM system-assigned managed identity, used ONLY as independent verification evidence against the live-resolved value below — never used as the functional principal passed to any role assignment. A mismatch fails this deployment closed.

The SQL VM system-assigned identity principalId, live-resolved from the existing VM resource and verified to match expectedSqlVmPrincipalId. Callers should use only this output functionally — never expectedSqlVmPrincipalId directly.

Grants an already-resolved, already-verified principal exactly one built-in Storage Blob Data Reader role assignment, scoped to exactly the existing mssql-2022-source blob container inside the existing salimsmgmtwe storage account — never storage-account, resource-group, or subscription scope. Part of the narrow LIMS WS2025 DEV v2 SQL installation-media container RBAC exception in docs/scope.md. Creates no storage account, container, account key, SAS token, or additional identity; references both the storage account and container as existing resources and modifies neither.
Name of the existing storage account hosting the installation-media container, e.g. salimsmgmtwe. Referenced only as an existing resource — not created, modified, or redefined here.
Name of the existing blob container to grant read access to, e.g. mssql-2022-source. Referenced only as an existing resource — not created, modified, or redefined here.

The already-resolved, already-verified principalId of the SQL VM system-assigned managed identity (see modules/compute/lims-ws2025-dev-sql-media-rbac/resolve-sql-vm-identity.bicep). This module performs no verification of its own and resolves no identity — it only consumes this value.
Full ARM resource ID of the single Storage Blob Data Reader role assignment created by this module.
Full ARM resource ID of the exact container scope this role assignment targets (never the storage account, resource group, or subscription).
DEV subscription ID the SQL VM identity was resolved from (derived from sqlVmResourceGroupResourceId).
DEV resource group hosting the SQL VM.
MGMT subscription ID the role assignment was deployed into (derived from storageResourceGroupResourceId).
MGMT resource group hosting the storage account.
Live-resolved, verified principalId of the SQL VM system-assigned identity actually granted access.
Full ARM resource ID of the single Storage Blob Data Reader role assignment created.
Full ARM resource ID of the exact container scope this role assignment targets (never the storage account, resource group, or subscription).
